concerns.text: T004 excludes weapons ROI entirely, citing 'SCR-002', but no SCR-002 exists in plan.md (only SCR-001 is recorded) and spec FR-008 still requires Detectron2 weapons masks. T004 only 'verifies the SCR-002 file exists' — a task cannot retroactively create the amendment that narrows FR-008. This is an unapproved requirement weakening; the amendment must be recorded and approved in the spec/plan chain before tasks rely on it.

FR-002 requires extraction of fixation latency, and T004 computes it, but neither dataset.schema.yaml nor T005's aligned_data.csv carries a latency column — the metric silently disappears before modeling. A task claiming FR-002 coverage must preserve all three metrics (first-fixation probability, dwell time, latency) into the analysis artifact, or the schema must be amended.

T006(b) halts the pipeline if VIF(salience, low-level features) > 5, but SCR-001's own rationale predicts VIF > 5 is exactly why the covariates were excluded. The task enforces a gate that the plan predicts will fire, guaranteeing the study can never complete. The VIF diagnostic must be recorded/reported (SC-006), not used as a hard halt under the amended design.

SC-003 defines power < 0.8 as 'Invalid for inference' regardless of p-value — i.e., the study is reported and marked invalid. T006(a) instead halts the pipeline when power < 0.8, so the spec-defined invalid-but-reported outcome (and output.schema.yaml's power_status: 'invalid') can never be produced. T008's power_status field becomes unreachable.

Plan sets a 4-hour salience-generation goal; T003's resource validator enforces 21600 s (6 h). The enforced threshold does not match the plan's stated constraint — either align the validator to the plan's goal or record the relaxation in the plan.

Plan's Task Summary references T013a, T020e, T029c, T030b, T031, T032, T037–T042, T049, which no longer exist in the re-planned T001–T010 list. The tasks' 'Revision behavior' section asserts preservation but provides no mapping; add a plan-item → consolidated-task traceability map so no plan acceptance criterion is silently dropped.
